0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-2, 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back) in the third game of the Kings' season, and Sacramento has lost its last two. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Keegan Murray is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while Memphis is missing Zach Edey (ankle), with Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Karim Lopez (knee bruise) both day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the 2025-26 season series ended with the Kings losing 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 123-114 Kings win in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
